Phase Four - Post-Vaccination Phase (Back to Normal)

Live with COVID-19: management consistent with other infectious diseases Open international borders, quarantine for high-risk inbound travel (Implemented 21 Feb) Uncapped entry for all inbound vaccinated persons, without quarantine (Implemented 21 Feb) Uncapped entry of non-vaccinated travellers subject to pre-flight and on arrival testing Vaccine boosters as necessary
